newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 11.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 11.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Property and insurance group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Thursday its US$400 million acquisition of Equitable Cos Inc's real estate unit would lift its gearing to 17 percent, but was self-financing.

The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission said on Thursday it would take into account the Wallis report into the financial system when considering Westpac Banking Corp's bid for Bank of Melbourne.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.94 (+0.05)

The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd on Thursday confirmed media reports that it would cease preliminary exploration in six countries and close some mineral exploration offices to accelerate its more promising projects.
Stadium Australia stapled shares and stadium memberships float at 11.00 a.m. (0100 GMT).

WMC Ltd said on Thursday it would be midday Friday at the earliest before it could fully assess the damage to its Kalgoolie, Western Australia, nickel smelter that caused the plant to close last weekend.
